name: lightsout

author: David Christian

scripts.bundle: esbuild packages/cli/src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.md=text --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cjsRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cjsRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=plugin/dist/cli.mjs
